##  PAN / New PAN
  * [हिंदी](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-procedure.html#hindi)
[ How do I apply for PAN? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-procedure.html#english-01)
You can apply for PAN by filling up Application for Allotment of Permanent Account Number (PAN application form). The forms are -
  1. Form 49A (for Indian Citizens) 
  2. Form 49AA (for Foreign Citizens)

PAN application can be made either online through Protean web-site [tinpan.proteantech.in](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/index.html) (Click [here](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/pan-index.html) to apply for PAN online) or through any of the Protean TIN-Facilitation Centres/ PAN Centres (Click [here](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/tin-pan-center.html) to select the nearest TIN – Facilitation Centers/ PAN centres where PAN application may be submitted). [ Can I make an application for PAN on Plain Paper? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-procedure.html#english-02)
No. Application for PAN can be made only be done using the prescribed formatas notified by Central Board of Direct Taxes, The notified forms are as under 
  1. [Form 49A](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/pan/download/Form_49A.pdf) (for Indian Citizen)
  2. [Form 49AA](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/pan/download/Form_49AA.pdf) (for Foreign Citizen). [ Where can I obtain PAN application form? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-procedure.html#english-03)
You can obtain PAN application form from any Protean TIN-Facilitation Centre (TIN-FC)/ PAN Centre or any other stationery vendors providing such forms. The same can be downloaded from Protean-TIN website. Click [here](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/pan/downloads-pan.html) to download the form. [ Are there any charges for obtaining PAN application form? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-procedure.html#english-04)
No.The form is freely downloadable from Protean e-Gov-TIN website. Click [here](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/pan/downloads-pan.html) to download the form. You can also obtain the form from any Protean e-Gov TIN Facilitation Center (TIN-FC)/PAN Center free of cost. [ Where should I submit my PAN application? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-procedure.html#english-05)
You can submit your duly filled and signed PAN application form along-with the supporting documents to any of the [TIN-FCs or PAN Centres](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/tin-pan-center.html) managed by Protean e-Gov.However, if applied online, duly signed and photo affixed acknowledgement receipt alon-gwith supporting documents should be sent to below address: 
**INCOME TAX PAN SERVICES UNIT  
5th Floor, Mantri Sterling, Plot No. 341,   
Survey No. 997/8, Model Colony,   
Near Deep Bungalow Chowk,
